market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver reaching $120 by mid-2026 would require a ~300% rally from current ~$30 in ~15 months, far beyond its all-time nominal high of ~$50. No plausible fundamental or speculative scenario makes such a move likely; the true probability is under 1%, while the market implies 6.8%.
evidence_points: Silver spot price is ~$30; $120 is a >4x multiple from current levels.
Historical silver all-time high is ~$50 (nominal), and even inflation-adjusted highs remain well below $120.
Only 15 months remain; commodities rarely sustain >100% annual gains outside hyperinflationary collapses, which are extremely unlikely by mid-2026.
